body.statement: For sufficiently small fixed amplitude constants, every \(P_{s,\lambda}\) belongs to \(\mathcal M_H\), its observed cell probabilities are uniformly positive, \(\tau_s(x_0)=-4sab+O(a^3b)\), and the one-record mixtures coincide exactly: \(\mathbb E_\lambda[P_{+,\lambda}]=\mathbb E_\lambda[P_{-,\lambda}]\).
body.justification: The legal witness must combine target separation, exact-uniform positive design, Hölder membership, and singleton cancellation.
body.gap: Kennedy et al.'s fuzzy family uses a support geometry tailored to nonprivate Hellinger affinity; the banked private microcell witness failed CATE smoothness when \(q<\gamma\).
body.consumer: It supplies a same-class causal hypothesis family for a privacy lower bound without support holes.
